thread:
marie: Customer reported intermittent 502/504s hitting hosted embeddings endpoint since ~2026-03-16T03:40Z. Occurs under concurrent large-batch requests (~100KB payloads). Seen across three regions. Customer says error spikes when they rotate auth tokens on their side.

raj: Can you paste a sample request id + minimal repro? any recent deploys or rollouts at that time?

marie: sample trace ids: trace=01a2b3c4d5e6f789; trace=01a2b3c4d5e6f790. Repro curl:
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <rotating-token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input": ["x...x"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings --max-time 60

luke: quick look at edge logs: multiple upstream resets + h2 stream errors around same traces. Envoy shows "response stream closed before end of headers" and RST_STREAM. Snippet:
[envoy] 2026-03-16T03:41:02Z upstream reset: reason=RST_STREAM code=2 stream_id=87462 route=/v1/embeddings peer=10.12.8.34:443
Also seeing repeated "HTTP/2 WINDOW_UPDATE stalled" warnings. No OOM on upstream containers; CPU/mem stable.

meera: on runtime side we did a small canary rollout for embeddings-large at 03:38 UTC (10% traffic) to test quantized weights. That rollout causes cold KV cache misses (prefix cache) for a subset of traffic. If auth backend (billing check) adds 100-200ms and we also hit cold cache, tail latency increases a lot. H2 window exhaustion + auth latency could explain 504s.

marie: customer provided repro script. Steps: 1) open 50 connections, 2) POST 100KB body per connection, 3) rotate Authorization header every 10 requests (simulate token refresh). Baseline: 1-2% 502. With token rotation: 6-9% 504/502.

luke: that pattern smells like head-of-line blocking in downstream h2 streams + upstream auth call delays. Envoy by default will time out long tails — check upstream_timeout and idle timeouts. Also check connection:keepalive / max concurrent streams.

meera: immediate mitigations I suggest: - rollback canary to 0% for embeddings-large (done queued) - increase upstream request timeout for /v1/embeddings from 30s -> 60s temporarily - throttle tenant to reasonable RPS (customer agreed to 20rps) - add short auth-cache TTL to reduce synchronous billing calls for same token

dan: customer comms: we should tell them we suspect an interaction between auth latency and a recent model rollout; note mitigations and ETA.

marie: updating customer: "We identified increased auth backend latency coinciding with a canary rollout; we've rolled back the canary, throttled your tenant to 20rps, and increased upstream timeouts while we monitor. Please re-run your repro and send traces if you still see errors." :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INF-3421 created by meera. Priority: P2. Assignees: meera, luke, marie.

luke: engineering follow-ups: add more aggressive H2 WINDOW_UPDATE handling, consider raising default per-connection `initial_window_size` for embeddings pool, and add early-fallback to smaller model variant when auth latency > 200ms. I'll open INF-3422 for runtime changes.

meera: created rollout rollback and runtime PR to increase window + fallback logic. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/runtime/pull/2760

marie: customer confirmed error rate dropped to 0.3% after rollback + throttling. Monitoring 30m window.

raj: good job. Please add a short postmortem note if this reoccurs; include trace ids and repro steps so we can tune h2/keepalive defaults.

marie: noted. Closing loop with customer in 2h if stable.
